note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Galaxy Backbone new data-centre facility in Lagos
entries.reason: Galaxy Backbone's Customer Service Week post of 20 October 2026 (local gbb-customer-service-week-20261020.html) reports its managing director as saying the company had 'recently secured a new data centre facility in Lagos'. No address, building, operator handover, construction or operating stage, or capacity is given, so neither a status nor a locator can be fixed, and it may be a tenancy in an existing Lagos facility rather than a new site.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Galaxy Backbone statement naming the Lagos facility's address or host building and its stage (announced, under works, operating), plus an operator-published or operator-linked locator.

entries.candidate: Teraco CT1 expansion status date (existing project; possible status correction)
entries.reason: The existing project curated:teraco-ct1-rondebosch-data-centre:current-expansion records under_construction as of 2026-07-17 from the Teraco release 'Teraco announces CT1 data centre expansion in Rondebosch, Cape Town'. That release (captured 27 October 2026, local teraco-ct1-expansion-news.html, sha256 4a120830...) is dated 12 November 2025 in its body and JSON-LD datePublished; 2026-07-17 is only its JSON-LD dateModified, a site-wide edit of Teraco's posts. The release announces commencement of the expansion and an early-2027 completion target. No newer dated Teraco statement on the expansion exists (news archive newest item 28 May 2026; the 28 September 2026 Cape Town page does not mention it). A queue fragment cannot express a status correction, so this is recorded for review rather than changed.
entries.reopen_condition: A reviewed status correction setting the expansion's observation to the release date (12 November 2025) with the replaced status evidence named, or a newer dated Teraco statement of the expansion's stage (construction, completion or opening).

entries.candidate: Digital Realty African facility pages (Lagos LOS1, LOS2, LKK1, LKK2; Accra ACR2; Maputo MPM1; Mombasa MBA1, MBA2; Nairobi NBO1)
entries.reason: Digital Realty's facility pages (captured 27 October 2026, local dlr-*-20261027.html) publish addresses and operator coordinates (for example LKK1/LKK2 at Mopo Onibeju Village, Ogombo Road, 6.4258, 3.6459/3.6467; ACR2 at Bank Street and Prof. Atta Mills High Street, Accra, 5.542241, -0.206357; MPM1 at 140D Avenida Vladimir Lenine, Maputo, -25.950476, 32.590457; MBA1 Miritini, Mombasa, open since 2017; MBA2 Kongoni Road), but the pages carry no in-page date, status statement or dateModified; only the English sitemap lastmod values (20 August to 16 September 2026) date them, and no archive copy was fetched to bound a version. Several are small edge facilities (LKK1 and LOS1 about 300-350 m2 and 200 kW). The NBO1 page's point (-1.32226, 36.70718) lies 5.51 km from the Atlas NBO2 Karen-campus locator, although the 7 September 2026 release says NBO2 was built alongside NBO1; the 22 October NBO1 hold therefore also needs this location conflict resolved.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Digital Realty, Teraco or iColo release (or Digital Realty's third-quarter 2026 results) naming a facility as operating or under works, or an archive-bounded in-window page version with a present-tense operating statement; for NBO1, resolution of the 5.5 km conflict between the Digital Realty point and the Karen campus locator.
